mentions.name: wellbody
mentions.description: This app provides guided body health by integrating fitness, nutrition, mindfulness, and recovery into a single unified system, and refines it into just 3 daily actions for users to follow.
mentions.problem: Most people know they need to integrate fitness, nutrition, mindfulness, and recovery into their goals but don't know what to do or find it difficult to organize all these topics into one system.
